ranking_policy: Rank by cross-batch topical coverage first (a paper matched by queries from several searcher batches sits closer to the centre of author-style imitation), then LibWit relevance score, then citation signals, then recency within the 2023-01-01 window. Keep one unversioned arXiv URL per paper and retain every matched topic for auditability.
anchor_note: Catch Me If You Can? Not Yet (EMNLP 2025) is the anchor. Its four measurement families - authorship attribution, authorship verification, style matching, AI detection - define the success metrics the reviewers score against.
